title: DRIP-R: A Benchmark for Decision-Making and Reasoning Under Real-World Policy Ambiguity in the Retail Domain

bias_targets.methodology: Correlating customer service resolution outcomes (the balance between customer goal alignment and company interest alignment) with the Big Five personality traits (Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism) of the simulated user personas to evaluate whether agents unfairly reward specific personality types.
